name: Huly - Frontend
description: An all-in-one project management platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
requires:
This application requires separate MongoDB, MinIO and ElasticSearch instances. See documentation: https://github.com/hcengineering/huly-selfhost/blob/main/template.compose.yaml 
        [br]
        This is the frontend container for Huly. Other Huly containers are required to run the entire suite.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Needs to match across all Huly containers. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`

variables.name: Accounts URL
variables.description: URL for the accounts service (this container). Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: Rekoni URL
variables.description: URL for the Rekoni service. Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: Calendar URL
variables.description: URL for the Calendar service. Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: Gmail URL
variables.description: URL for the Gmail service. Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: Telegram URL
variables.description: URL for the Telegram service. Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: ElasticSearch URL
variables.description: URL for the ElasticSearch service. Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: Huly Collaborator URL
variables.description: URL for the Huly Collaborator service. Replace with server IP address and correct port.

variables.name: MinIO Storage Configuration
variables.description: MinIO storage configuration. See documentation for more information: https://github.com/hcengineering/huly-selfhost/blob/79062e681f84358a8ac15d5af7c81561db3c891a/template.compose.yaml#L56

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Internal port for the server. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Uploaded Files Location
variables.description: Location for uploaded files. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Default Language
variables.description: Default language for the site. Not recommended to change.
